nodes.note: The porch the clerk comes in by, south of the hall: a door into the hall.
The wardens' hall: a broad stone stair three wide climbs its east wall to the lane, and the great hearth stands in its north wall at the stair's foot, its fire before a grate.

stations.note: The fire on the hearth stone before the mouth, put out and washed away when the flue floods.

nodes.note: Wardens' Lane, open to the sky at the head of the stair: a street four wide with a lamp post at its edge half-way along, and the flue's sluice at its far end.

stations.note: The sluice lever at the lane's south end, which floods the flue.

nodes.note: The wardens' passage behind the hearth: as wide as the stair, and the records at its end.
